main_body: Multi-storey school building: a flat green rooftop seen from above (parapet, roof garden, vents, skylight) over a cream front wall with four rows of windows and a glass entrance
top_band: Roof surface in green (L~115-155) with a light parapet rim above it, rows ~7-38 in the scan, followed by a light front-edge line at rows 39-40
evidence: The column scan shows a clear horizontal roof surface: light parapet at rows 1-5, then green rows 7-38, with props (AC unit, vent, skylight) standing on it. A light parapet edge at rows 39-40 and a green and grey band at rows 44-45 mark the front edge and shade the face. Below that is a tall vertical cream wall with inset windows (dark frames, sills) and a recessed glass door under a canopy. The roof is a deep top surface and the front is a separate face, so it reads as 3/4 and not as an elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: Median 10 colours per tile is close to house-h112 (11) and below h101 (18). Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines are tinted (dark green and blue-grey). The roof has several greens with tuft dots and the wall has speckle. The windows have 3-4 blue steps with diagonal glints and the brick base is shaded. The 12% flat-fill coverage comes from small areas of cream wall and is minor. The distinct colour count of 43 is lower than the references, but the piece is clean and not sticker-like. It holds up acceptably next to the reference.
